12/11.09.2024
The learned counsel for the petitioner and the opposite party no.2 are present.

2.  The learned counsel for the petitioner submits that the opposite party no.2 was convicted for offence under sections 498A and 323 of Indian Penal Code in G.R. No.583 of 2006 arising out of Bhandra P.S. Case No.61 of 2006 (T.R. No.43 of 2013) and as per section 498A, the prescribed punishment is imprisonment and fine.

He submits that the petitioner being the informant of the case is aggrieved by the order passed by the appellate court whereby the sentence has been modified and a fine amount of Rs.50,000/- only has been imposed.
He submits that the modification of sentence is contrary to the prescribed punishment.

He has also submitted that the learned trial court had given the punishment of 1  years simple imprisonment with fine of Rs.5,000/- under section 498A of IPC and simple imprisonment for three months under section 323 of IPC to the opposite party no.2.

sentences.text:
The learned counsel for the petitioner submits that the opposite party no.2 was convicted for offence under section 498A of Indian Penal Code in G.R. No.372 of 2003 arising out of Bhandra P.S.
Case No.29 of 2003 (T.R. No.42 of 2014) and as per the said section, the prescribed punishment is imprisonment and fine.

He submits that the petitioner being the informant of the case is aggrieved by the order passed by the appellate court whereby the sentence has been modified and a fine amount of Rs.50,000/- only has been imposed.
He submits that the modification of sentence is contrary to the prescribed punishment.
He has also submitted that the learned trial court had given the punishment of three years simple imprisonment to the opposite party no.2.
He submits that section 386 of Cr.P.C. has not been considered, which deals with the power of the appellate court.
The learned counsel for the opposite party no.2 submits that the matters be posted day after tomorrow.

4. Post these cases day after tomorrow i.e. on 13.09.2024 in the supplementary cause list.
(Anubha Rawat Choudhary, J.) Saurav/-
